stories.headline: Mistral just raised €3B at a €21B valuation
stories.blurb: The French AI lab closed a €3 billion Series D led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, and PSG Equity. The round values Mistral at €21 billion — a signal that 'sovereign AI' (models built outside Big Tech's orbit) is becoming a serious market category with serious capital behind it.
stories.why_it_matters: European AI is now funded like a tier-1 competitor to OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.original_headline: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business

stories.headline: Qualcomm will build custom AI chips for Amazon's data centers
stories.blurb: The smartphone chip giant signed a multi-generation deal to supply Amazon with data center processors, marking Qualcomm's biggest push into AI infrastructure. Amazon also gets the option to buy up to $4 billion in Qualcomm shares.
stories.why_it_matters: Qualcomm is betting its chip design chops can compete with Nvidia in cloud AI hardware.
stories.original_headline: Qualcomm Signs Deal to Provide Amazon With Custom AI Chips

stories.headline: DeepMind just mapped what happens when you change any letter in human DNA
stories.blurb: AlphaGenome Atlas predicts the molecular effects of all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes across the human genome. It's a reference map researchers can use to understand which genetic variants might cause disease and which are harmless—without running wet-lab experiments for each one.
stories.why_it_matters: Turns genetic diagnosis from experimental guesswork into a lookup table.
stories.original_headline: AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome

stories.headline: Runway just hit $200M in revenue selling AI video to marketers
stories.blurb: The AI video startup crossed $200 million in annual recurring revenue in September, driven by companies using its tools to generate marketing materials and ads. That's real enterprise traction for generative video beyond demos and side projects.
stories.why_it_matters: AI video tools are becoming production infrastructure, not just experiments.
stories.original_headline: AI Startup Runway Hits $200 Million in Annual Recurring Revenue

stories.headline: Google gets $1.9 billion federal loan to restart a dead Iowa nuclear reactor
stories.blurb: A U.S. regulator approved nearly $2 billion to bring a shuttered Iowa nuclear plant back online — power that will flow directly to Google's AI data centers. It's the first major federal loan backing nuclear energy specifically for tech company AI infrastructure.
stories.why_it_matters: Big Tech is now getting government-backed nuclear power to feed AI's energy demands.
stories.original_headline: US regulator approves $1.9 billion loan to spin up Iowa's dead nuclear reactor for Google

stories.headline: Claude can now send your emails if you let it
stories.blurb: Anthropic's AI assistant can now draft and send emails through Gmail with your permission. You can set it to ask for approval before hitting send, so you review everything before it goes out. It works through Claude's computer use feature that lets it interact with apps on your behalf.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents are moving from answering questions to actually doing things in your inbox.
stories.original_headline: How to let Claude send emails for you

try_this_prompt.title: The priority collision detector
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'll list everything I'm supposed to be focusing on this quarter. Don't affirm them all or ask me to rank them. Instead, tell me which two are structurally incompatible — where succeeding at one makes the other nearly impossible — and force me to pick one to actually deprioritize.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: When your roadmap looks achievable until you try to execute all of it at once.
